headline: West Asia turmoil drags markets; Sensex, Nifty tumble over 1% - OrissaPOST
summary: Benchmark indices closed more than 1% lower, tracking weak Asian markets as the West Asia conflict intensified and oil prices rose. The 30-share Sensex fell 1.40%.
why: The Sensex and Nifty are India's main benchmark equity indices, tracking large listed companies on the BSE and NSE.
